context.transcript:
Thank you to the Clayton Museum for inviting me to give this presentation about my most recent publication.
My book focuses on the history of the pottery makers who used to thrive here in Clayton.
In 1850, only one pottery company made clay bowls and containers.
By the next century, over 50 factories were making tableware, such as plates and teacups.
Tea sets were very popular at that time.
As you can see, there are several antique tea sets on the table here next to the podium.
You are welcome to come and take a closer look after I'm finished speaking.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢 Clayton Museum 邀请我在这里就我的最新出版物进行这次演讲。
我的书重点介绍了曾经在克莱顿繁盛的陶器制造商的历史。
1850年，只有一家陶器公司制作粘土碗和容器。
到了下一个世纪，超过50家工厂都在生产餐具，比如盘子和茶杯。
那时茶具非常流行。
正如您所看到的，讲台旁边桌子上摆着几套古董茶具。
在我说完之后，欢迎您过来仔细看看。
